implemented: Machine-readable exact pair handshake contracts in scripts/release-identity.mjs, scripts/release-evidence.mjs, and scripts/release-candidate.mjs: distinct BFF image digest types (oci_manifest_digest, image_config_digest, archive_checksum - never conflated), lease ({ owner, epoch, runId, delegated }), preparedArtifact ({ locator, checksum }), expectedPredecessor ({ pairId, commit, artifactDigest, target }), compatibilityDigest, releaseId, and mandatory gate evidence.

Positive prepare protocol in scripts/deploy-dev-vm.sh: stages exact dev-public-origin FE assets, qualifies candidate against staged non-public BFF via PANTHEON_BFF_CANDIDATE_TRANSPORT, leaves incumbent live symlink untouched, emits durable prepared_success in release-evidence hash chain and writes .prepared-receipt.json with 29-field integrity hash, exiting 0.

Positive activate protocol in scripts/deploy-dev-vm.sh: executes in a new process without rebuilding, verifies prepared receipt (29-field SHA-256 hash, non-future preparedAt <= now + 60s, TTL <= 3600s, expiresAt not expired) and fresh same-epoch environment lease (owner, epoch, runId, delegated=true), enforces expected predecessor CAS even on replay, checks all 5 mandatory gates (candidateVerification, preSwitchProbe, agoraCompatibility, managementFleet, openclawContract), atomically exchanges DEPLOY_ROOT symlink, and verifies independent served readback. Idempotent replay succeeds without rebuilding or re-staging.

Strict restore protocol in scripts/deploy-dev-vm.sh: requires valid .prepared-receipt.json for write-proof releases, authenticates lease authority with delegated=true, owner, epoch, and runId matching receipt before switching to safe read-only sibling.
Retired one-shot public-switch bypass in scripts/deploy-dev-vm.sh without compatibility alias; unauthenticated or unphased execution fails closed with exit code 2.

Aligned proof watchdog caller and workflow in .github/workflows/pantheon-proof-watchdog.yml and .github/workflows/pantheon-dev-fe-deploy.yml to pass and verify lease parameters (owner, epoch, runId, delegated=true).

Gated write-proof proof coordinator in .github/workflows/pantheon-dev-fe-deploy.yml so deploy_action=prepare safely runs prepare without arming watchdog, activating, or running proof, exporting prepared_release_dir and prepared_receipt from steps.write_prepare.

Updated .github/workflows/pantheon-integration-gate.yml to wire staged candidate transport to browser probe and identity verification curl, pass --bff-image-repository and --bff-image-tag when digest is present, and declare job-level environment variables within GitHub Actions 25-input dispatch limit.

Hardened probe-hosted-browser-bff.mjs: strict IPv4 loopback regex rejecting spoofed hostnames (e.g. 127.attacker.example), genuine browser CORS preflight check with OPTIONS dispatch, and preserved candidate path prefixes in route fulfillment.

reviewer_findings_resolved.1_parent_lease_authority_and_delegation: Both activate and restore strictly authenticate fresh parent lease authority; LEASE_DELEGATED=true is enforced and delegated=false fails closed. Restore requires .prepared-receipt.json when current release is write-proof and matches lease owner/epoch/runId. Watchdog caller and workflow pass lease_owner, lease_epoch, lease_run_id, lease_delegated.
reviewer_findings_resolved.2_receipt_mandatory_integrity_and_bounds: Mandatory receiptIntegritySha256 recomputed over all 29 fields in canonical order. Embedded verifier checks preparedAt <= now + 60s (no future timestamps), TTL <= 3600s, and now <= expiresAt (no expired receipts).
reviewer_findings_resolved.3_mandatory_management_openclaw_gates: scripts/deploy-dev-vm.sh consumes browser probe JSON to verify managementFleet (personaFleetSafetyPassed !== false) and openclawContract. All 5 mandatory gates must have passed status in receipt.
reviewer_findings_resolved.4_observed_exact_bff_image: Preserves PAIR_ROOT_DIR before subdirectory mutations. verify_bff_identity verifies observed image repository, tag, digestType, and digest match expected. Disallows substituting unobserved caller image in release-identity.mjs.
reviewer_findings_resolved.5_staged_candidate_transport_and_image_f: .github/workflows/pantheon-integration-gate.yml routes candidate transport to browser probe and curls candidate transport for /bff/version. Passes required --bff-image-repository and --bff-image-tag to prepare-pair when image digest is set.
reviewer_findings_resolved.6_browser_cors_preflight: scripts/probe-hosted-browser-bff.mjs performs genuine browser CORS preflight check (OPTIONS request) for non-simple methods/headers, aborting route if preflight fails or lacks access-control-allow-origin.
reviewer_findings_resolved.7_preserve_candidate_path_prefix: Candidate URL construction in probe-hosted-browser-bff.mjs preserves candidate path prefixes (e.g. /staged) when rewriting candidate routes.
reviewer_findings_resolved.8_reject_changed_predecessor_on_replay: Predecessor comparison is executed outside !isReplay, and atomic activation CAS validates requested predecessor against receipt unconditionally.
reviewer_findings_resolved.9_prepare_only_write_proof_and_outputs: proof-coordinator in pantheon-dev-fe-deploy.yml runs write_prepare before watchdog dispatch. When deploy_action=prepare, watchdog dispatch/arming, activate, proof dispatch, child claim upload, and proof wait steps are all gated and skipped. Outputs prepared_release_dir and prepared_receipt are exported from steps.write_prepare.
reviewer_findings_resolved.10_candidate_host_ipv4_loopback: Hostname loopback check in probe-hosted-browser-bff.mjs strictly parses IPv4 loopbacks using /^127\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/u, rejecting spoofed domain names.

downstream_handover_contract.DEV-DELIVERY-001: FE deployment interface exposes separated PANTHEON_DEPLOY_ACTION=prepare (outputs prepared-release-dir, .prepared-receipt.json with TTL 3600s and 29-field integrity hash) and PANTHEON_DEPLOY_ACTION=activate (requires lease_owner, lease_epoch, lease_run_id, lease_delegated=true, predecessor CAS). Pruning retains unexpired prepared receipts. Failure during activate retains safe sibling for parent rollback.
downstream_handover_contract.STRUCT-RETIRE-001: One-shot switch bypass is permanently retired with exit code 2. No compatibility aliases exist. All deployments must execute through governed prepare -> activate or explicit restore.
